title: July 21-29th and August 4th: Anagama Firing with Aarti Manik
bring: 4-4.5 cubic feet of cone 10 bisque fired works; optional stuffer pieces 3x2x2
commitment: 9 days: load Days 1-3, fire Days 4-8 (24-hour schedule for 100 hours), kiln cool 6 days, open/unload Day 9
how_to_join: Click 'Purchase' button on workshop page or pay online via PayPal; call 845-332-6585 or email absartorius@gmail.com for alternative payment
source_quote: July 21-29th and August 4th: Anagam Firing with Aarti Manik
summary: A 9-day anagama wood firing workshop emphasizing loading and firing techniques for varied surfaces. Participants work cooperative 24-hour shifts for 100 hours, bring bisque-fired work, and return to unload 6 days after firing cools.
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes an anagama firing where participants work shifts during a 24-hour schedule for about 100 hours of firing time, learning stoking patterns and kiln control.
evidence_quote: Days 4-8 : Participants work together during their agreed upon shifts to fire the anagama. Learning about a variety of different stoking patterns, how to control the kiln, manage the coal bed, and learn from the process of wood firing. This is a 24 hour firing schedule for about 100 hours of firing time.
